notes.title: Changing the world - first information
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/4be85aaaac344c99e3bedc5ac362fbe6c08fe566.png[/img]

last 40 days we have been working hard on a new world and now know that it wasn't easy as expected - that's also why there were almost no updates about planned change. All energy was invested into the preparation, debug, testing and new changes.

There were several iterations before we found a suitable final result for the game, so it meets all the requirements and bring as little as possible compromises.

Old world (let's call it "Legacy") is really big and basic shape resembles two islands - boundaries are made of water. The priority during creation of this legacy world was to secure a big oversight and truly dense flora with many trees. Gradually, the concept began to show a poor possibilities to optimize, ability to add more content into the game and especially the overall gameplay. Big world with only one biome (European forest) and repeating flora is boring over time and limiting the development of the game. Given size and generation logic of the world began to show his rather large drawbacks than benefits.

More than 90% of the players never left the starting location and moved only within a radius of a few hundred meters around the starting tower (even players who have recorded more than 100 hours of game time). Legacy world itself doesn't give incentives to its exploration and discovery. That is really a shame when the world is already so large and unnecessarily detracts from the performance and blocks the development of content. But it is logical and there is no reason to wonder if it is all basically the same thing - it becomes boring and slow game does not force players to do research or to motivate his actions to more distant locations.

The new world is built on the basis of these knowledge and experience, even though from the beginning will not be filled with massive content, but will not restrict us from adding any new content in future.

Legacy world bound hands us a lot in developing the game. More and more we ran into limitations and need to resolve problems to do something that cannot be done easily - because the concept of the game was always slightly modified and adjusted according to the requirement of the players over time (especially if the game is in the early access).

So we had to make a big decision and cancel the Legacy world and create new foundation stone for the game. This whole decision was complicated by one of our rule and this is do no wipe players' content. Unfortunately, this change is not possible without wipe in timely manner. As we touched wipe topic so explain it more. Wipe will be related only to houses and objects placed on the ground in the world - simply:
Character and content of the inventory - will not be wiped.
Houses and constructed objects - will be deleted, but you'll get all raw materials back into your inventory.
So you can start with the old character and all your items in your inventory, but you lose your houses and buildings - we know it's annoying, but other solutions are impossible - we are so sorry. On the other hand, we'll try at least to save all your raw materials and ease building itself in the new world (more about that later in the next announcement).

[h1]A fundamental limitation of Legacy world:[/h1]
1) Too big world
2) Poorly defined AI and pathfinding - unsustainable in such a big world without significant shortcomings causing performance and other issues.
3) Restrictions on adding content - although we have an anomaly, but the basic world became boring space.
4) No motivation to leave the starting zone.
5) Adding content that lack logic with the original concept and we are so throwing obstacles in the way of the future development of the game.
6) Too big initial focus on supervision and megalomaniacal world.
7) Hard to add static POIs or other content thanks to players' objects all over the world.
8) Backdrop of the world was limitation caused by prepared teraforming that was planned to be added one day.
9) And much more...

[h1]So what will new world bring, and what are these changes for the good?[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/feee6fee19fa3c4ca94f2a252128f72d952abe16.png[/img]

1) The aim was to maintain or even improve the visual impression of the game - so the changes will not be drastic at first sight - at second glance yes.
2) The entire world will have a smaller base - about one half - but still it takes about hour to get to other end.
3) The boundaries of the world are made of mountains. In the Legacy world, it was water.
4) Decreased the number of large masses of water - the basis of new world are much smaller ponds, but only one large lake in the center of the map.
5) The world is more rugged and more fun for exploration and still it is very easy to get lost.
6) Sidewalks/paths were added - which are used to determine the basic movement throughout the world (but not serve as an accurate route from one place to another - only assist in orientation).
7) New World has a much better AI pathfinding and movement.
8) World contains 4 biomes (instead of one in the Legacy world): Mountain Forest, Grassland, Desert (rather badlands) and Jungle.
9) Thanks to these biomes it's possible to add more animals into the game and not be limited solely to anomalies.
10) Entrances to anomalies and POI have fixed places where it's possible to enter or visit them - a lot of players have had a problem with their randomness.
11) A simple option to expand the world in the future.
12) More interesting places in the world.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/d3ffeeb0018b61983851aa0458ce3cab96979cb5.png[/img]

[h1]Smaller outline innovations and changes in the gameplay, that will come with the new world:[/h1]
1) Bonuses for progress in generation - such as passive skill points, points for enabling recipes (old characters -> each character will get appropriate number of points depending on achieved generation).
2) Recipes "Blueprints" will continue to be found around the world or in anomalies, but they could be learned with points (if you will miss specific recipe it's nothing easier than purchasing it with generation points).
3) Possibility to build a house from prepared templates (suitable for players who do not have the nerves or the time to design a house from A to Z).
4) Change in interaction with the environment and the entire core of some game elements.
5) Change the logic of construction and occupation of the land (more later).
6) Option to occupy territory and expose mining station here (more later)
7) And much more - but this is about future announcement as development progress.

[h1]Major disadvantages of the new world:[/h1]
Wipe on some things.
Canceling planned teraforming on the terrain.
Shorter vision
Smaller water areas (but will compensate with other worlds + anomalies).
[strike]Inability to cut down trees[/strike] * (EDIT: Possibility to cut down trees in a game eventually remains).

[h1]Teraformation:[/h1]
We had to reject and cancel planned teraformation of the terrain (even when it was working good in our internal tests).
Instead, we plan to add teraformation in slightly different form and the ability to add blocks pseudo terrain (possibility to create a flat plane for the house - more later).


EDIT: Possibility to cut down trees in a game eventually remains!
[strike]
[h1]Cutting trees canceled - what?[/h1]
Yes it is true - cutting trees and their disappearance from the world is probably even bigger compromise than wipe of data . It had to happen with regard to the world changes and all the bugs associated with this (not so much about flying the trees in the air etc.) But most of the data affair and demands for data and performance (which we needed elsewhere).

[h1]There are two reasons why the game needs cutting trees:[/h1]
1) Raw tree log for players (100% of the players)
Solution: A new style of construction will need a lot of wood - this will ensure mining stations (over time you will not have to worry about the supply of logs). From the start, although you have to obtain wood by hand, but only until you can secure the supply of raw materials through the stations. Either way, you will still be able to find and get the wood you need for specific purposes(for example, oak, etc.).

2) To release the space for the plot - place for house (5% of players)
This problem is solved by better deployment of flora around the world and more areas for home building.

[h1]How will a player earn wood:[/h1]
1) The logs will be acquired similarly as in legacy world - using an axe to hack out the tree (but tree will not disappear - just temporarily run out of raw material - like branches).
2) Use mining stations.[/strike]

--------------------
[i][h1] * Edit:[/h1]
Possibility to cut down trees in a game eventually remains.[/i]
--------------------


Additionally, we apologize for the late notice, but we did not want anything to discharge to the public until the final decision. Lots of us all stretched solving AI, which was really difficult and we had to have a few things to modify and customize.

We hope that you'll accept new world positively and accept its shortcomings compared to replace legacy to future content and gameplay.

[h1]And about what interests you the most - when it finally be out?[/h1]
During the first days of March we will have done the world as a whole and then we move on to tuning changes in gameplay without which the game could not go out - it will not be prolonged unnecessarily (we can always add other news updates). We hope, therefore, that at the end of March (early April) would perhaps everything be ready and prepared for release.

Thanks so much for your time and patience!

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/4be85aaaac344c99e3bedc5ac362fbe6c08fe566.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/aff49051f0ba50d33d5c525be3cefc0faafa9ec1.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/d3ffeeb0018b61983851aa0458ce3cab96979cb5.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/7851da6d910a93678a0efaf2e36f0f92d40507fc.png[/img][/url]
[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/feee6fee19fa3c4ca94f2a252128f72d952abe16.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/fdab85414acc472a48d7e9041e8659ad8f7800a9.png[/img][/url]

3) Possibility to build a house from prepared templates (suitable for players who do not have the nerves or the time to design a house from A to Z).
4) Change in interaction with the environment and the entire core of some game elements.
5) Change the logic of construction and occupation of the land (more later).
6) Option to occupy territory and expose mining station here (more later)
7) And much more - but this is about future announcement as development progress.

[h1]Major disadvantages of the new world:[/h1]
Wipe on some things.
Canceling planned teraforming on the terrain.
Shorter vision
Smaller water areas (but will compensate with other worlds + anomalies).
[strike]Inability to cut down trees[/strike] * (EDIT: Possibility to cut down trees in a game eventually remains).

[h1]Teraformation:[/h1]
We had to reject and cancel planned teraformation of the terrain (even when it was working good in our internal tests).
Instead, we plan to add teraformation in slightly different form and the ability to add blocks pseudo terrain (possibility to create a flat plane for the house - more later).


EDIT: Possibility to cut down trees in a game eventually remains!
[strike]
[h1]Cutting trees canceled - what?[/h1]
Yes it is true - cutting trees and their disappearance from the world is probably even bigger compromise than wipe of data . It had to happen with regard to the world changes and all the bugs associated with this (not so much about flying the trees in the air etc.) But most of the data affair and demands for data and performance (which we needed elsewhere).

[h1]There are two reasons why the game needs cutting trees:[/h1]
1) Raw tree log for players (100% of the players)
Solution: A new style of construction will need a lot of wood - this will ensure mining stations (over time you will not have to worry about the supply of logs). From the start, although you have to obtain wood by hand, but only until you can secure the supply of raw materials through the stations. Either way, you will still be able to find and get the wood you need for specific purposes(for example, oak, etc.).

2) To release the space for the plot - place for house (5% of players)
This problem is solved by better deployment of flora around the world and more areas for home building.

[h1]How will a player earn wood:[/h1]
1) The logs will be acquired similarly as in legacy world - using an axe to hack out the tree (but tree will not disappear - just temporarily run out of raw material - like branches).
2) Use mining stations.[/strike]

--------------------
[i][h1] * Edit:[/h1]
Possibility to cut down trees in a game eventually remains.[/i]
--------------------


Additionally, we apologize for the late notice, but we did not want anything to discharge to the public until the final decision. Lots of us all stretched solving AI, which was really difficult and we had to have a few things to modify and customize.

We hope that you'll accept new world positively and accept its shortcomings compared to replace legacy to future content and gameplay.

[h1]And about what interests you the most - when it finally be out?[/h1]
During the first days of March we will have done the world as a whole and then we move on to tuning changes in gameplay without which the game could not go out - it will not be prolonged unnecessarily (we can always add other news updates). We hope, therefore, that at the end of March (early April) would perhaps everything be ready and prepared for release.

Thanks so much for your time and patience!

Hello everyone,

we have prepared another new update. This is not a huge update, but rather minor repairs and a few details. And it will be a longer period of last update (do not worry we will not end with work on our game (ːnipictoː Novus Inceptio is our baby and we fulfilling our dream with developing this game) - we are now full of energy and we work of our game every day).

But why this break in updates?

Since we are preparing big changes and this changes require time to implement and can not be released in small increments.
Mainly it will be a change around the world, the core code, making in the world a lot of other things we need to fix the core - which requires a lot of work.

We are aware that our game has a lot of shortcomings and bugs and many of them are caused in the core, which must change. A long time, we analyzed and reviewed bugs and repair is necessary, but not easy - even when our game is just an early access, it is more complex than it seems, and if we want to achieve our promises and all planned. We need started in time of changes and not try to repair small things.

We will keep you regularly informed here on Steam, about new changes  - in few days will be the first information about the main changes, compare their advantages and disadvantages in comparison with the current state of the game.

But do not worry the changes are not such that they would change the logic and meaning of our game - quite the contrary.

We thank everyone for their support, ideas and reporting bugs - although sometimes we are not able to respond immediately and in time - but believe that everything we read it carefully and write down notes.

Now we need your support and patience more than ever -  we thank you!

Below is a list of changes for today's update:

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]You no longer need to finalize building components - after addition of raw materials is this building component completely finished.
[*]In the settings (Section gameplay) is a new option to disable game mouse sensitivity and used as raw input sensitivity from your OS or hardware settings.
[*]Added option to rotate objects while laying on the ground using the Page Up and Page Down (scroll mouse can still be used)
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Anomalies - Fixed FPS drop - especially in postapo anomalies
[*]POI - minor bug fix for cloning abandoned station
[*]Fixed problem with Collider at some objects - causing eventual crash
[*]Repairing bad translation in the tutorial when tutorial requires "rope" instead of "twine"
[*]Repair placement of items in the Container, if it is a mass placing items - actions "put down all".
[*]Improved memory management - when loading raw data items from DB - also affects the disturbance minor lag.
[*]Slightly reduced demands on memory.
[/list]

[h1]Hotfix 0.10.018[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed a problem with the extraction of raw materials.
[*]Fixed problem with defining the material during production.
[/list]

[h1]Hotfix 0.10.019[/h1]
[list]
[*]Restoring the original work with memory when recording RAW data items from DB - new version caused unforeseen problems, and will be appropriately reviewed.
[/list]

[h1]Hotfix 0.10.020[/h1]
[*]Removing lens flare effect at A2 and drone.
[*]Added option to rotate objects in building mode using the Page Up and Page Down (scroll mouse can still be used)
[/list]

notes.title: 0.10.016 - Ending Christmas Event
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

so we have a new little update, which mostly ends Christmas event.

Also brings minor repairs, but also a greater and this is a ability to set water quality, we hope that this opportunity will help with crashing games for some players (where a crash caused by water).

Another major update will come this time a little later, as we were worked out many changes to the game and is currently undergoing internal testing of basic elements (whether it will be possible to change implentovat the game) - once we were finished the test, so we will inform you about the new changes that will be implemented .

Thank you all very much for your support and affection to our game - it helps us very much in charge of energy and possibilities to realize our plans together with your knowledge!

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Turning off the Christmas event
[*]Reduce the required skill for producing beds
[*]Item "Rope" renamed to "Twine"
[*]Option to turn off the dark border around the screen - Settings -> Gameplay section
[*]Ability to set water quality - Settings -> Performance section
[*]Removed option to disable Help keys on the right side (this feature has not been a long time in the game - it was in settings useless)
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed some German texts.
[*]Fixed problem with opening craft window in some situations.
[/list]

We are aware of many shortcomings and bugs in the game, watching all yours observations and comments. But repairs are not easy, and for some it is necessary to fix more things around so that everything worked correctly.

notes.title: 0.10.013 - Christmas event
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/79fbd43af6d69a980ffd8ba87256dfcda5e8fd7c.png[/img]

Hello everyone, 

first we want to wish you all Merry Christmas and Happy New Year 2017.
We thank you very much everyone for all the encouragement and support you have given us this year - we much appreciated this - without you, the players - the game would not be where it is today!

This is the last update for this year (if nothing serious happens) - we need a little rest and spend some time with the our family. But year 2017 will be great, we plan a lot of things and hopefully we are able to implement everything.

Well, so what brings the new update, there's not much, but ...

The first is a Christmas event - not as mad as a Halloween event, but it brings new rewards, items and achievements. All is quiet in the spirit of Christmas with just a lighter atmosphere and yes you have the opportunity to build a Christmas tree to your home.

Your new home can also improve with new lights such as lamps and candlesticks on the table or floor, but also on the walls.

Remember, Christmas gifts may contain valuable raw materials such as graphite, gold and barrel Blueprints!

Well, good hunting, and again Merry Christmas and Happy New Year!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/adf9e1bb956d6d26d64c68e3fcef185362aad146.png[/img]

[h1]Christmas event[/h1]
[list]
[*]Christmas event runs from 16 December 2016 to 3 January 2017
[*]New Christmas achievements
[*]The new Christmas currency - "Christmas token"
[*]New Christmas object - posible to find randomly in the world (great gift), from which you can get Christmas bonuses.
[*]New items in the trade terminal (in "event" section):
[*]- Christmas Canes
[*]- Christmas Cookies
[*]- Christmas Dessert
[*]- Christmas Red Hat
[*]- Christmas Tree - small
[*]- Christmas Tree - big
[*]- Christmas Gift - small
[*]- Christmas Gift - medium
[*]- Christmas Gift - big
[*]Christmas gifts can include interesting items that are normally difficult to obtain as:
[*]- Graphite
[*]- Gold ore
[*]- Silver ore
[*]- Blueprint
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/74f913e96edd315b070c58cc56825295f8bdd7d7.png[/img]

[h1]New content - Lights[/h1]
[list]
[*]All items are available for production through carpentry station
[*]Candle (Available from the beginning)
[*]Table lamp (Available from the beginning)
[*]Wall lamp (necessary to obtain a blueprint)
[*]Wall torch (necessary to obtain a blueprint)
[*]Wall candlestick (necessary to obtain a blueprint)
[*]Candlestick table - small (Available from the beginning)
[*]Candlestick table - medium (necessary to obtain a blueprint)
[*]Candlestick - medium (necessary to obtain a blueprint)
[*]Candlestick - big (necessary to obtain a blueprint)
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Modified formula for generating rocks - already should not generate on tree trunks.
[*]Lights from fires, torches etc. They are primarily off when this items is placing to ground (if is a day).
[*]If there is any open container (small and large barrel), so double-clicking on item in your inventory or A2-A warehouse moved this item into the container (instead of the A2-A or inventory)
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Repairing the system name for saw
[*]Repair door to the abandoned cloning station
[*]Repairing stairs to the abandoned cloning station
[*]Repair interaction on some rocks
[*]Correction of error in the formula for improving tools, weapons and armors
[*]Correction vizual value of age when player is revived after death.
[*]Correction weight calculation for A2-A when is A2-A empty.
[/list]

[h1]0.10.014 - Hotfix[/h1]
[list]
[*]Correction calculations of bonuses to armor and weapons.
[*]Adjusting music in a cave / dungeon anomaly.
[*]Wall and desk lamp has not lit whole day, but only during the night.
[*]Fixed some collision on a specific object.
[/list]

[h1]0.10.015 - Hotfix[/h1]
[list]
[*]Correction calculations Christmas tokens for achievement - if tokens are gained from small Christmas presents (in inventory).
[*]Smaller corrections placement Big Christmas gifts in the world.
[*]Reduced spawn Big Christmas gift of 3% in the world.
[/list]

BTW: nice idea for a streetlight from our players!

notes.title: 0.10.012 - Next performance
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
last weeks experience was a lot of bugs, that arose by transition project to the engine version 5.4.2, which could not be easily removed.
We spent last week with engine tuning - revert to the latest stable version 5.3.x - but this was not very well possible, because the game itself already contains a lot of new things powered by features in newer engine version. We therefore decide and on the latest version 5.5.0, and we will try to fix the underlying problems.
Some were already handled and some is still under detail look to find a source - especially character jumping up in the air (very sorry for this - we are really searching for fix, but the problem is really very complicated).

Anyway, aside with this update which optimizes many things that we are using, we were able to optimize many other things related to rewitting code due to update. 
This all combined means that performance was tweaked up a bit and memory requirements was decreased.

Fix minor bugs - there wasn't too much time to deal with major issues and adding new content - issues with core update took too much time.

Also, we have combined the player's inventory and A2-A storage (only visually into a single UI) - a lot of new players have problems with understanding that there are two inventories. And even some of the players already familiar with our game still have some problems with this.


There is a huge question that we really like to know some feedback related to inventory logic.

There are three options we could go:
1) Leave original version (separate inventories, scales and limitations)
2) Use current version (inventories merged to single window, smaller characters's space, same scales and limitations)
3) Merge both inventories together (physicaly and visualy, unlimited carry limit, only weight of worn items, belt and tools are counted)

Another improvements in this field related to better organization (filtering, search) are planned, we are now doing a first but great step

Please reply in the comments - Thanks!


Well, almost forgot. Nominations to "IOTY2016" was started - if you want to, you can nominate our game at this link: http://www.indiedb.com/games/novus-inceptio
Nominations will be followed by final voting - then if we success during nominations we will need your help again

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/31e303b35b51ec52149149a41fef2b9b086a62ea.png[/img]

[h1]Performance[/h1]
[list]
[*]After a very big trouble upgrading to Version 5.5.0 Unity (at the expense of color saturation game environment).
[*]Improving render terrain.
[*]Fixed some problems with collisions.
[*]Improve the behavior of some parts of the code.
[*]The game now requires much less RAM.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The player's inventory is now merged with the A2-A storehouse (visually in one UI) - still in WIP!
[*]Buttons removed for opening A2-A warehouse or player's inventory from the lower part of the two inventories.
[*]Visual reduced the number of visible slots in the player's inventory.
[*]Reduced coefficient for calculating the maximum carrying capacity of the character.
[*]Reduced coefficient for calculate maximum hit points of character (globally reduced)
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Already it is possible to improve tool - sewing kit.
[*]Repair description for player torch.
[*]Repairing effect of rain.
[*]Removing the light flickering for static torchs.
[*]Repairing the Czech translation of the text for some items.
[*]The game has correctly remembers the camera view before a death (FPS or 3rd) after a revival character of the camera view returns to the previous view.
[*]"Chair - Leather" now requires "Leather pack" to produce.
[/list]

Hello everyone, 
so we have a new update and this time finally delivers equipment for your home;)

This update brings into play the 63 new items for your home!
Furthermore, brings two new production stations and the ability to produce natural dyes (which are mostly use for the production of items for your home).

And as always we repaired some of bugs.

Thanks so much for your encouragement and support!

And lest we forget - Steam launched a special event during the Autumn discounts "The Steam Awards" - if you like our game, so do not hesitate to give vote (we prefer the category: The 'I Thought This Game Was Cool Before It Won An Award" Award , but any vote in any category is for us a great appreciation) - we thank you very much in advance!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/ff70e3472394aac30f9321cade9287fa43095ed3.png[/img]

[list]
[*]New recipe for calcium and silicon (it is possible to use extraction or production)
[*]New weaving station
[*]New tool - Weaving Kit
[*]Cloth, Cloth pack, leather pack etc. now require tool Weaving Kit for productions!
[*]New carpentry station
[*]All furniture recipes were moved to the new station Carpentry
[*]New items - dyes (found mainly use for dyeing (during production) household items etc.):

[*]Brown (necessary to obtain a blueprint)

[*]1 new big barrel (it is necessary to obtain a blueprint)
[*]1 new decorative pot (you need to get a blueprint)
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]adjusted calculation for the resulting mouse sensitivity after setting the options (necessarily reconfigure to suit your needs!)

[/list]

[list]
[*]repair of production - indicator of resulting quality reacts only if the recipe includes some ingredients
[*]repair interaction and collision on rocks, trees, ores, etc.
[*]repair spawn wolf - decreased number in low level zones
[*]repair deletion of building parts, when a player moves during building mode via free look game camera.
[/list]

notes.content:

Hello everyone, 

we would also point out to November's "Game Developers Sessions 2016" event in Prague - during which (03.- 07. November) our activity will be more or less limited (thank you for understanding). 

But now we've got another new update! 

[h1]Item Tooltip & Material bonuses[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/d014ae4c8603ae61fd9ca2111c442cb18f3037d7.png[/img]

[h1]Crafting stations[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/daca58f4b4c9e7c6d2f2805c6f1d9a2db8f94467.png[/img]

[h1]More types of mining raw ores[/h1]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/12eb751052c4f349725212527b5d3ee2ce1bb60e.png[/img]



[h1]Items Tooltip and Material bonuses[/h1]
[list]
[*]Item mouse over tooltip - now shows more information.
[*]Tooltip shows how much the item is added to food, water, etc. stamina.
[*]Bonus system was applied according to the material.
[*]Tooltip shows (where items any have), which includes bonuses this item.
[*]Bonuses depending on the material ("ATK+", "DEF+", "Craft QL+", "Harvest QL+", "Harvest Drop chance+", "Price value+ ", "HP regen" (When player gets or doit hit in combat", "Lowering decay"))
[*]It is possible to build specific and unique items (targeted for attack, defense, renewal of life or a better tool for obtaining raw materials or production).
[/list]

[h1]Crafting Stations[/h1]
[list]
[*]It is possible to produce a production station (Forge, alchemical, kitchen) via base craft - "workbench" section
[*]Into these stations were moved some recipes + some new ones (new smelting).
[*]The original fireplace now allows only cook Roast (other recipes is only in the kitchen)
[/list]

[h1]Furnace changes[/h1]
[list]
The original building component for the "Furnace" is no longer part of the building!
This building was replaced with a new item crafting station "Forge".
All built "Furnace" are changed to "Forge" - suggest to take and adjust the position.
[/list]

[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
[*]The new raw metal material - Copper
[*]The new raw metal material - Tin
[*]The new raw metal material - Silver
[*]The new raw metal material - Gold
[*]The new item - Raw Copper Ore
[*]The new item - Raw Tin Ore
[*]The new item - Raw Silver Ore
[*]The new item - Raw Gold Ore
[*]The new recipe - Smelt raw Copper Ore
[*]Basic Ingot can be done even from new materials (Copper, Tin, Silver, Gold)
[*]The new raw mineral - Graphite (can be obtained at very low% over rocks forage)
[*]The new special smelting Ingot - Pure Copper

notes.title: 0.10.001 - Really big update
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/b4846b620432084e6e0a71a17544d019c8a66416.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

this update is really huge according to number of changes made.

There are many new features and changes so it was impossible to describe all of them in changelog or right there in text.

[h1]Reworked whole UI[/h1]
UI is now more user friendly a reflects (almost) everything. Our game is really complex and many inside mechanics weren't presented in useful form or at all. New UI should be much more intuitive especialy to newcomes.
Well, of course you can expect tweaks and probably fixes on this field.

But as usual, one picture is more than thousand of words. Check it out or even better, see you in game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/397e987e98101657e937004d6aef902a3b1d5ab8.png[/img]

[h1]Trading terminal[/h1]
Trading terminal was added to game, there you can buy and sell stuff.
Terminal can be found in main tower, or you can build one by yourself (blueprint needed).
Please keep in mind that this new feature is just kickoff, there will be much more stuff in future.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/8e015bdc523486443e06deabdce2d8e78bc6847e.png[/img]

[h1]Fighting overhauled[/h1]
Fighting got new UI, it should be also much more intuitive and reflecting battlefield situation. Now it should be much easier to understand against what are you standing.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/4748ae4fc29d93828e7319c01f86b7db995170c1.png[/img]

[h1]Halloween event[/h1]
First halloween event was started. Game is now little bit crazy, but that's what halloween is.
Event will be ended on November 7th 2016, so it will run for 2 weeks and will be triggered every year from now.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/d1a10f9b12120c292124f8b11e29ffdd7a0f8d48.png[/img]

[h1]Improve your tools, weapons and armor[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/37bdc009b55065a720280a8f23bb664e69553be3.png[/img]

And as usual, changelog (but please keep in mind that there are many things missing)

[h1]Halloween event[/h1]
[list]
[*]He begin 1st Halloween event 2016 in NI
[*]World's slightly mad;)
[*]Three special Halloween monsters.
[*]Special drop / currency - new item "Halloween token".
[*]Trick or Threat pumpkins randomly around the world.
[*]Special items for purchase per "Halloween tokens" in the store.
[*]Candy foods, Halloween tonic, pumpkin lamp, halloween hat...
[/list]

[h1]Trade terminal[/h1]
[list]
[*]Trade terminal was added to the game.
[*]Starter items for purchase are really just for starting;)
[/list]

[h1]Fight[/h1]
[list]
[*]Monsters have lv - which affects their attributes.
[*]Level is generated according to the distance from the starting tower.
[*]Aggressive monsters LV2 and less - aggressive up only when a player attacks to him.
[*]Monsters have new lives pointer, level, attack and defense.
[*]Monsters have a pointer when attacking.
[*]The player and the monsters have a visualization for detection zones (for attack or defense).
[*]Improved synchronization of attack and defense with players and monsters
[*]Players don't repeat combo, if you don't hold the attack button
[*]Monsters no longer collide with a player (not jumping over his head;))
[/list]

[h1]UI changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The entire basic UI has been changed !!!
[*]Not possible to write everything here - it is really a lot.
[*]Chat is now draggable window.
[*]Chat is not longer open by default
[*]Increased draggable element for dragging the craft window
[/list]

[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Possibility to upgrade weapons, tools and armor - via Imroved kits
[*]Improved kits need to be manufactured - it is produced through a anvil crafting window (anvil need to lying on the ground and opening her craft box via action menu).
[*]Improve is done using RMB for proper items (a weapon, tool, armor)
[*]New item - (Improve kit for weapons)
[*]New recipe for (Improve kit for weapons))
[*]New item - (Improve kit for tools)
[*]New recipe for (Improve kit for tools))
[*]New item - (Improve kit for armors)
[*]New recipe for (Improve kit for armors))
[*]New item - (Fat) - can be obtained from some dead monsters.
[*]New item - (Trade terminal - own trade station)
[*]New recipe for (Trade terminal - as new world blueprint))
[*]New event item - Candy apple
[*]New event item - Candy corn
[*]New event item - Candy pumpkin
[*]New event curencie - Hallowen token
[*]New event resource - Trick or Thread
[*]New creature - Crazy Pumpkin
[*]New creature - Vampire Dark Bat
[*]New creature - WickedWitch
[*]Added some new achievements
[/list]

[h1]Aging[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved aging
[*]All characters now have to start zeroing age value - 18years
[*]All characters with a starting generation - 1
[*]Now the figure is aging faster - Played 1 hour in a game (in real clock) = 10 years figures
[*]Character dies of old age around 75 years of age and obtained a new generation
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Tweaked the time needed for production - better skill = faster production,
[*]Adjusted basic formula for calculating attributes for attack and defense with weapons and armor.
[*]When a player hits a creature - weapon gets some damage.
[*]When a creature hits a player and player not defend - specific piece of armor gets some damage.
[*]When a creature hits a player and player defend - shield gets some damage.
[*]Monsters now give some extra loot (not only meats and skins) - preparation for more loots
[*]Changed action keys for salvage the building component - the action is only possible using the action key plus left shift key.
[*]Fight now increases even slightly defensive skill
[*]Defense now increases even slightly fighting skill
[*]In the safe zone (towers and deeds) is no longer possible switch to battle stance and attacking to monsters.
[*]Hit points are now automatically filled only if the player is in the safe zone (tower or deed).
[*]New player have fishing skill in the skill bar
[*]Starter knife is directly set as the active weapon.
[*]A lighted torch is already affecting the temperature of the player.
[*]The torch now not ignite only at night - but always ignited while it is active.
[*]The reed is not an herb, but the raw material (such as grass, leaves - suitable for ropes).
[*]Reed reduced drop.
[*]Skills (botanize, forage, climbing, fishing) have new icons
[*]"Healing cover" and "Bandage" Now healing HP according to their QL / Tier
[*]Any food already does not fill a stamina!
[*]When placing any items on the ground (drop, drop all, place), is no longer the primary active mouse.
[*]Adjusted coefficients for calculating additions hunger by eating food
[*]Thirst already correctly affects fitness
[*]HP is no longer a fixed value - but the maximum number HP is increasing the skills and character generation
[*]Skills can only be added into main skillbar
[*]If the player standing in the water, not automatically drinking - it is necessary to do it action for drink.
[*]Thirst and hunger declining much faster.
[*]After drinking or eating is activates a specific timeline stop state for declining the attribute (depending on the item)
[*]Each skill bar now has 10 slot
[*]Chat system now showing when is added items into inventory the number of pieces
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Performance - improvements FPS drops and lag in the generation of the world and movement.
[*]Adjusted visual format (commas, spaces, dots) for currency (PEC) - now are displayed according to your local settings of your PC.
[*]Corrected visual data (onmouse tooltip) updates after repair tools, weapons, armor.
[*]Fixed some items' descriptions.
[*]Fighting stance (activation and deactivation) is possible only after the proper animation sequence have ending - can no longer dispense command changes attitudes.
[*]When filling water bottle from wells - the well has correctly returns the filled bottles with their original properties (tier etc.).
[*]If you want to destroy a well, so it already does not take so long.
[*]No longer will be generated trees and shrubs on towers' ramps
[*]Audio for mining already corresponds with animation.
[*]If canceling of mining is interrupting correct animation.
[*]If canceling of cutting trees is interrupting correct animation.
[*]Audio for chopping already corresponds with animation.
[*]Fixed issue with spawning monsters in the player house
[*]Fixing issue with animation when interrupting fishing
[*]Correction factor for filling stamina - if you're thirsty to zero.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/397e987e98101657e937004d6aef902a3b1d5ab8.png[/img]

[h1]Trading terminal[/h1]
Trading terminal was added to game, there you can buy and sell stuff.
Terminal can be found in main tower, or you can build one by yourself (blueprint needed).
Please keep in mind that this new feature is just kickoff, there will be much more stuff in future.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/8e015bdc523486443e06deabdce2d8e78bc6847e.png[/img]

[h1]Fighting overhauled[/h1]
Fighting got new UI, it should be also much more intuitive and reflecting battlefield situation. Now it should be much easier to understand against what are you standing.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/4748ae4fc29d93828e7319c01f86b7db995170c1.png[/img]

[h1]Halloween event[/h1]
First halloween event was started. Game is now little bit crazy, but that's what halloween is.
Event will be ended on November 7th 2016, so it will run for 2 weeks and will be triggered every year from now.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/d1a10f9b12120c292124f8b11e29ffdd7a0f8d48.png[/img]

[h1]Improve your tools, weapons and armor[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/37bdc009b55065a720280a8f23bb664e69553be3.png[/img]

And as usual, changelog (but please keep in mind that there are many things missing)

[h1]Halloween event[/h1]
[list]
[*]He begin 1st Halloween event 2016 in NI
[*]World's slightly mad;)
[*]Three special Halloween monsters.
[*]Special drop / currency - new item "Halloween token".
[*]Trick or Threat pumpkins randomly around the world.
[*]Special items for purchase per "Halloween tokens" in the store.
[*]Candy foods, Halloween tonic, pumpkin lamp, halloween hat...
[/list]

[h1]Trade terminal[/h1]
[list]
[*]Trade terminal was added to the game.
[*]Starter items for purchase are really just for starting;)
[/list]

[h1]Fight[/h1]
[list]
[*]Monsters have lv - which affects their attributes.
[*]Level is generated according to the distance from the starting tower.
[*]Aggressive monsters LV2 and less - aggressive up only when a player attacks to him.
[*]Monsters have new lives pointer, level, attack and defense.
[*]Monsters have a pointer when attacking.
[*]The player and the monsters have a visualization for detection zones (for attack or defense).
[*]Improved synchronization of attack and defense with players and monsters
[*]Players don't repeat combo, if you don't hold the attack button
[*]Monsters no longer collide with a player (not jumping over his head;))
[/list]

[h1]UI changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]The entire basic UI has been changed !!!
[*]Not possible to write everything here - it is really a lot.
[*]Chat is now draggable window.
[*]Chat is not longer open by default
[*]Increased draggable element for dragging the craft window
[/list]

[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Possibility to upgrade weapons, tools and armor - via Imroved kits
[*]Improved kits need to be manufactured - it is produced through a anvil crafting window (anvil need to lying on the ground and opening her craft box via action menu).
[*]Improve is done using RMB for proper items (a weapon, tool, armor)
[*]New item - (Improve kit for weapons)
[*]New recipe for (Improve kit for weapons))
[*]New item - (Improve kit for tools)
[*]New recipe for (Improve kit for tools))
[*]New item - (Improve kit for armors)
[*]New recipe for (Improve kit for armors))
[*]New item - (Fat) - can be obtained from some dead monsters.
[*]New item - (Trade terminal - own trade station)
[*]New recipe for (Trade terminal - as new world blueprint))
[*]New event item - Candy apple
[*]New event item - Candy corn
[*]New event item - Candy pumpkin
[*]New event curencie - Hallowen token
[*]New event resource - Trick or Thread
[*]New creature - Crazy Pumpkin
[*]New creature - Vampire Dark Bat
[*]New creature - WickedWitch
[*]Added some new achievements
[/list]

[h1]Aging[/h1]
[list]
[*]Improved aging
[*]All characters now have to start zeroing age value - 18years
[*]All characters with a starting generation - 1
[*]Now the figure is aging faster - Played 1 hour in a game (in real clock) = 10 years figures
[*]Character dies of old age around 75 years of age and obtained a new generation
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Tweaked the time needed for production - better skill = faster production,
[*]Adjusted basic formula for calculating attributes for attack and defense with weapons and armor.
[*]When a player hits a creature - weapon gets some damage.
[*]When a creature hits a player and player not defend - specific piece of armor gets some damage.
[*]When a creature hits a player and player defend - shield gets some damage.
[*]Monsters now give some extra loot (not only meats and skins) - preparation for more loots
[*]Changed action keys for salvage the building component - the action is only possible using the action key plus left shift key.
[*]Fight now increases even slightly defensive skill
[*]Defense now increases even slightly fighting skill
[*]In the safe zone (towers and deeds) is no longer possible switch to battle stance and attacking to monsters.
[*]Hit points are now automatically filled only if the player is in the safe zone (tower or deed).
[*]New player have fishing skill in the skill bar
[*]Starter knife is directly set as the active weapon.
[*]A lighted torch is already affecting the temperature of the player.
[*]The torch now not ignite only at night - but always ignited while it is active.
[*]The reed is not an herb, but the raw material (such as grass, leaves - suitable for ropes).
[*]Reed reduced drop.
[*]Skills (botanize, forage, climbing, fishing) have new icons
[*]"Healing cover" and "Bandage" Now healing HP according to their QL / Tier
[*]Any food already does not fill a stamina!
[*]When placing any items on the ground (drop, drop all, place), is no longer the primary active mouse.
[*]Adjusted coefficients for calculating additions hunger by eating food
[*]Thirst already correctly affects fitness
[*]HP is no longer a fixed value - but the maximum number HP is increasing the skills and character generation
[*]Skills can only be added into main skillbar
[*]If the player standing in the water, not automatically drinking - it is necessary to do it action for drink.
[*]Thirst and hunger declining much faster.
[*]After drinking or eating is activates a specific timeline stop state for declining the attribute (depending on the item)
[*]Each skill bar now has 10 slot
[*]Chat system now showing when is added items into inventory the number of pieces
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Performance - improvements FPS drops and lag in the generation of the world and movement.
[*]Adjusted visual format (commas, spaces, dots) for currency (PEC) - now are displayed according to your local settings of your PC.
[*]Corrected visual data (onmouse tooltip) updates after repair tools, weapons, armor.
[*]Fixed some items' descriptions.
[*]Fighting stance (activation and deactivation) is possible only after the proper animation sequence have ending - can no longer dispense command changes attitudes.
[*]When filling water bottle from wells - the well has correctly returns the filled bottles with their original properties (tier etc.).
[*]If you want to destroy a well, so it already does not take so long.
[*]No longer will be generated trees and shrubs on towers' ramps
[*]Audio for mining already corresponds with animation.
[*]If canceling of mining is interrupting correct animation.
[*]If canceling of cutting trees is interrupting correct animation.
[*]Audio for chopping already corresponds with animation.
[*]Fixed issue with spawning monsters in the player house
[*]Fixing issue with animation when interrupting fishing
[*]Correction factor for filling stamina - if you're thirsty to zero.
[/list]

Hello everyone, 

we have for you next update.
Which brings long-awaited torch for the players - the torch is necessary to insert into the slot weapon (lights automatically at night alone - but also the burning gets damaged to torch).
The well has also been added to the game, which can stand anywhere and used to receive water in hard to reach places (or as decoration for your home;))

[list]

[list]
[*]Repair unfocus chat input field after sending a text.
[*]Turning off the scrolling chat using motion keys
[*]Already it is possible to dive underwater.
[*]Remove a bug where it was possible to build components from another raw materials.
[*]Slightly modified performance.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.09.003 - 1st Anniversary event
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/b6d7501451e214b30d1a4c253f737cba27ccd0f9.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

it is amazing how time flies. It considers that it is only a few days when we launched our game into "early access" here on Steam. It was precisely October 5, 2015 at 18:00 CEST time.

For us it was a huge step and full year brought us many new experiences and knowledge. We were trying to bring new things to the game, and most importantly repair and upgrade basic game elements and logic. But we not fulfilled everything we wanted - unfortunately such is the development and priorities change with regard to your requirements and weaknesses in the game that surfaced. All in all it was a very hard work year and subsequent years are ahead of us.

We thank you very much everyone for your patronage, support and most importantly patience!

The first anniversary of our little we prepared a smaller event.

Event will last until the end of the week - it may be extended until 12 October 2016 (according to the interests of players).

[h1]During this event you can get:[/h1]
A unique achievement for playing Novus Inceptio ːnipictoː during this event.
Unique in-game item (a statue for our 1st anniversary - a unique achievement, representing this gift) - it is necessary to write in in-game chat this command " [b]/reward[/b] " ( without the quotes, but with a slash )
During the whole event is raised skill up 2x

We hope that you will be delighted and will remain loyal to our game.

We thank you! ːnipictoː

Below is a detailed description of the update:

[h1]1st Anniversary[/h1]
[list]
[*]Special unique sculpture as a reward for players (for players who play the game during the event)
[*]Special unique achievements for the players as a reward (for players who play the game during the event)
[*]The reward for the players in the form of in-game money (for players who play the game during the event)
[*]During this event Increased the skill up 2x
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Revaluation of all items in the game (preparing for the new trade terminal.).
[*]Wipe all the player's money (preparing for the new trade terminal.).
[*]Added crude ax - easier to produce and can be found in the manufacture of the tools.
[*]Bottom right menu now has even hint key (which can be used for the action on the menu - if that's possible)
[*]Inventory and A2-A storage - a new button to open a new inventory(A2-A or player backpack) now has a better sign for better understanding.
[*]Annulment LMB action for a action to salvage the building component - the event is only possible using the action keys.
[*]Temporarily disable options for sale items - before the new trade system comming.
[/list]

[list]
[*]Wipe all the player's achievements.
[*]Added some new achievements (preparing for another new).
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed problem with huge FPS drop during mass collection of raw materials from trees etc.
[*]Synchronization fix chat
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.09.001 - Improved fighting
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/3e45b8f482615249d96130a0bfdffa54df2afd16.png[/img]

Hello everyone,

After a very long pause (in visible progress) we have prepared a new update. This is not a little too big update, but the first sliver of the new changes and the directions of the game.

But first we would like to clarify why it was such a long delay. Pre we apologize for her and we hope that you understand everything and you still support us.

We will not draw up an essay, but we take it upon points:
[list]
[*]1) We needed a small vacation (we are only human and not a machine) and summer holidays were the perfect time to take a well-deserved rest.
[*]2) We read all the knowledge (discussion) from you players and also went through a lot of gameplay videos of our game - to get as much information and knowledge.
[*]3) All we have, we've outlined the key points and new things we want to add to the game.
[*]4) It was not really easy to complete about it all, and especially to assemble a rough outline of the future work done earlier and what later.
[*]5) We have completed all the paperwork regarding our new company for official development games (including the lengthy paperwork and registered in the US etc.)
[*]6) Has the purpose and meaning to the functioning of society - since the only income for development is only the sales are on Steam (and we do not fool ourselves, the game not gets many sold and not so much to be able firm to expand and hire new employees etc. - will still a long way).
[*]7) Also made a big personal life step (for us personally very important) - I got married;) Do not worry there is no divorce in the future that would threaten the development of the game (as some of you worried in the discussion here on Steam) - it was a confirmation volume after 10 years of cohabitation. This step but claimed another small break in the development in September - thank you for your understanding.
[/list]
But now we are back in full force and awaits us many things about the game. That we plan and will gradually release.

Thanks so much everyone!

PS: This pause is ultimately a very positive effect on the development - after this pause, the game is different and we see things that are wrong (and previously we have seen before - took it as automatic / logical).

But now the first update!

The new update is mainly focused on improving the fight (finally)! Although the fight is not still something extra perfect, but we think it is a big step towards better and fun fight. Without this step, we could not work on other changes that are in preparation, such as:
Changing logic anomalies.
Danger in anomalies.
More enemies.
Tutorial quests.
etc.


Below is a detailed description of the update:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/653c08282b1676abb5fc2924ce341a818318eda2.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/c2cffc6f6585aa7ffe8e03c7a9af5e81e206f50d.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/c168eecae63c39e7c3a3b801c194cb3012dbfdcb.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/6bde97399e5b7aba53b3c8d88f7b6e84ad10c519.png[/img]

[h1]Fighting update[/h1]
[list]
[*]Activated system attribute attack and defense
[*]Information about the current attack and defense, are available in the character window.
[*]Weapons and armor have an attack or defense attributes, depending on the type, tier and rarity.
[*]Adjusted strength, defense and hitpoints of creatures.
[*]Adapted defensive stance - smaller chance to be injured (which is necessary to treat with bandage)
[*]It's possible to attack during walking and running
[*]Reaction monsters to hit from a player (pause for the next reaction monsters - some monster animation).
[*]Character now has a small hit animation when get hit by monsters.
[*]Attacking now has chance to grant a combo. Holding the button for attack could lead in charged attack (there are two types 2 and 3 combo ) - each part of combo can hit monster.
[*]Fighting is much easier - with a good combat skill, it is possible to kill a deer with a sword.
[*]Deers no longer unnecessarily jump, but on a bigger % rather walk.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Possibility to restart the game without having to exit the application.
[*]Greater chance to get a blueprint that player has not yet own.
[*]Both player inventory and A2-A storage now have button to open other storage. Button contains info about number of items stored there.
[*]Unless prevented any action or activity is possible to go into battle stance using button for attack (default LMB)
[*]If a character is in a battle stance and has targeted an object in nature (tree, rock, etc.), which does not allow interaction in a battle stance. It is possible to disable a battle stance using the button for attack (default LMB)
[*]Defending during the fight no longer detract stamina.
[*]Each new character gets a three bottles of water.
[*]Primary and secondary actions on objects (like a tree, rock, etc.) Can now also be carried out with keys for attack and defense (default LMB and RMB).
Time to execute the botanize and forage (on the ground) was reduced.
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Repaired color of plants and the surrounding trees.
[*]Fixed a problem when you pause the game and open game options.
[*]When there is an active item (like wall or tree) its now posible click to behind bottom menu.
[*]If a player has no weapon in hands there are no longer sword sounds
[/list]

[*]5) We have completed all the paperwork regarding our new company for official development games (including the lengthy paperwork and registered in the US etc.)
[*]6) Has the purpose and meaning to the functioning of society - since the only income for development is only the sales are on Steam (and we do not fool ourselves, the game not gets many sold and not so much to be able firm to expand and hire new employees etc. - will still a long way).
[*]7) Also made a big personal life step (for us personally very important) - I got married;) Do not worry there is no divorce in the future that would threaten the development of the game (as some of you worried in the discussion here on Steam) - it was a confirmation volume after 10 years of cohabitation. This step but claimed another small break in the development in September - thank you for your understanding.
[/list]
But now we are back in full force and awaits us many things about the game. That we plan and will gradually release.

Thanks so much everyone!

PS: This pause is ultimately a very positive effect on the development - after this pause, the game is different and we see things that are wrong (and previously we have seen before - took it as automatic / logical).

But now the first update!

The new update is mainly focused on improving the fight (finally)! Although the fight is not still something extra perfect, but we think it is a big step towards better and fun fight. Without this step, we could not work on other changes that are in preparation, such as:
Changing logic anomalies.
Danger in anomalies.
More enemies.
Tutorial quests.
etc.


Below is a detailed description of the update:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/653c08282b1676abb5fc2924ce341a818318eda2.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/c2cffc6f6585aa7ffe8e03c7a9af5e81e206f50d.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/c168eecae63c39e7c3a3b801c194cb3012dbfdcb.png[/img]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/6bde97399e5b7aba53b3c8d88f7b6e84ad10c519.png[/img]

[h1]Fighting update[/h1]
[list]
[*]Activated system attribute attack and defense
[*]Information about the current attack and defense, are available in the character window.
[*]Weapons and armor have an attack or defense attributes, depending on the type, tier and rarity.
[*]Adjusted strength, defense and hitpoints of creatures.
[*]Adapted defensive stance - smaller chance to be injured (which is necessary to treat with bandage)
[*]It's possible to attack during walking and running
[*]Reaction monsters to hit from a player (pause for the next reaction monsters - some monster animation).
[*]Character now has a small hit animation when get hit by monsters.
[*]Attacking now has chance to grant a combo. Holding the button for attack could lead in charged attack (there are two types 2 and 3 combo ) - each part of combo can hit monster.
[*]Fighting is much easier - with a good combat skill, it is possible to kill a deer with a sword.
[*]Deers no longer unnecessarily jump, but on a bigger % rather walk.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Possibility to restart the game without having to exit the application.
[*]Greater chance to get a blueprint that player has not yet own.
[*]Both player inventory and A2-A storage now have button to open other storage. Button contains info about number of items stored there.
[*]Unless prevented any action or activity is possible to go into battle stance using button for attack (default LMB)
[*]If a character is in a battle stance and has targeted an object in nature (tree, rock, etc.), which does not allow interaction in a battle stance. It is possible to disable a battle stance using the button for attack (default LMB)

[*]Each new character gets a three bottles of water.
[*]Primary and secondary actions on objects (like a tree, rock, etc.) Can now also be carried out with keys for attack and defense (default LMB and RMB).
Time to execute the botanize and forage (on the ground) was reduced.

[list]
[*]Repaired color of plants and the surrounding trees.
[*]Fixed a problem when you pause the game and open game options.

[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.08.017 - Waypoints
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/1918ceda3110adb10f43583349dcbb75079ca7ef.png[/img]

Hello everybody,

so here we have another update.
This time the focus is on your own waypoints and improvements to the map of the world.

Unfortunately, you can not do waypoints by clicking on the map - blindsided us that future logic. But it is necessary to place waypoints manually in the world.
But you can let indicate the nearest tower etc.

Here is complete changelog: 

[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
[*]WAYPOINTS - a basic system for creating custom waypoints
[*]WAYPOINTS - custom waypoint is required to produce - the production section "HI-TECH" - requires an ancient crystal
[*]WAYPOINT - custom waypoint acts as an object in the world - has its own 3D model. When the location is automatically placed about half a meter in front of the player character (you can not define its own position).
[*]WAYPOINTS - Custom waypoint can be took for other uses.
[*]WAYPOINTS - new on screen indicator system, which displays the monitoring indicators in the game (direction and distance to any object - a waypoint ,towers, claim token etc.)
[*]WAYPOINTS - Claim token is automatically set indikator active (can be changed on world map)
[*]WAYPOINTS - custom waypoint is automatically set active (can be changed on world map)
[*]WORLD MAP - It contains a new legend for the map.
[*]WORLD MAP - You can filter the waypoints that show - player, towers, claim token or custom waypoints
[*]WORLD MAP - You can disable the names and details of waypoint - for better readability of the map.
[*]WORLD MAP - the possibility of setting on screen display for each waypoint - off and on - suitable for watching towers, claim token or custom waypoints set off when not needed (But only for targets that are not distant more than 6 km).
[*]WORLD MAP - Data on the active waypoints are saved only for the claim tokens and custom waypoints.
[/list]

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]CORE - The game automatically pauses when an open setting (only in game, not in main menu) - possible only for Single Player mode.
[*]Picking cherries and apples from the tree now improves "FORAGING" skill.
[*]Planting seedlings improves "GARDENING" skill.
[*]Mushrooming improves "FORAGING" skill.
[*]The harvested leaves from shrubs Improves "FORAGING" skill.
[*]The harvested azalea from shrubs improves "GARDENING" skill.
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed some issue with interaction.
[*]Fixed some issue with player jumping animations.
[*]Fixed some issue with crash game in winter anomaly (we hope will this help).
[*]Fixed issue with the problem blending into the night sky in the morning.
[*]Fixed issue with underwater plants that game defined as ground shrubs.
[*]Is no longer possible to lay the fireplace and other items on water levels - each item is placed on the surface of the ground (under water).
[*]Supplemented by missing labels for some items.
[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.08.016 - Gameplay changes and improvements
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/830a60c641ca001077dad286dfeaf768d4bcfdd2.png[/img]

Hello everybody.

So there is another nice update. This time is focused on overhaul of items and their management. First big change is great overhaul of items' weight so they are now more real. Another big change is water management. Now you'll need containers to carry water so you'll need to craft bucket or obtain bottles in postapo anomaly first. Due to future plans, we decided to remove damaging items when craft fails. However, every action now damages related tool so don't forget to watch over them or you'll destroy and lose them entirely. You can now anytime repair any damage on them for free (this will change over time). And, as usual, many small things and issue fixes.

Here is complete changelog:

[h1]Gameplay changes[/h1]
[list]
[*]WATER - Any existing water (water in the bucket) what you had in your inventory is converted to chemical element H2O. You can drink and use it for production, but cannot be dropped. Changes in the new game object (we did not want to delete your all the water so it can be used this way).
[*]WATER - Water cannot be collected by use of skill FORAGE when standing in water anymore.
[*]WATER - Water can now be collected via inventory and context over specific items (empty bottle or an empty bucket) - through action "filled with water." It is necessary to stand in the water!
[*]WATER - if you have more containers for water, it is possible to fulfill all batch action.
[*]WATER - Supplementing thirst accept the weight and type of item that serves as a beverage.
[*]GARDENING - Reduced time for removing crop fileds.
[*]GARDENING - Planted crops can no longer dry - applies only to the single player game mode
[*]ATOOL - It is no longer possible to activate the tool using shortcuts skillbars (losing that sense, as an active tool to define itself when it is placed in skillbars or is used as a weapon).
[*]ATOOL - Slot for the active tool (among skillbars) no longer used for possible drag items. It is used only for visual information about what is currently active tool for the design / implementation of the action.
[*]ATOOL - Currently used tool cannot be moved and is colored red.
[*]ATOOL - Active tool gets corect decay during use.
[*]DECAY - Resources are not damaged after failed crafting anymore.
[*]DECAY - Items are no more auto repaired after login.
[*]DECAY - It is necessary to watch over damaged tools, weapons, ..
[*]DECAY - Damage has been graphically shown only in case of damaged items (small indicator bar on the right side of the icon of the item that was previously pointed continuously).
[*]ITEMS - All items' weights overhaul
[*]ITEMS - Adapted drop and quality items (tier) correctly according to skill.
[*]ITEMS - A small chance to get higher tier items (than player should obtain based on skill)
[*]ITEMS - Corrected information in a chat about getting tier raw material (instead of quality)
[*]ITEMS - Items in inventory has now small icon (bottom left corner), representing TIER (applies for Tier 1 and above - Tier 0 has no icon).
[*]ITEMS - Tooltip now shows current TIER, below the icon for the item.
[*]ITEMS - Crude knife can be repaired.
[*]ITEMS - Tools can be repaired within the skillbars (RMB on item)
[*]ITEMS - The minimum weight for automatic transfer of new items to the A2-A was reduced to 0.5 kg (as default). You can adjust this value in gameplay section in settings (allowed is 0.1 to 2.0 kg).
[*]SETTINGS - In section "gameplay", it is possible to disable/enable fishing game - and go fishing original (legacy) mode. There are no bonuses in legacy fishing (however, they are not present in newer mode as well .. yet).
[*]TREES - Now it is possible to collect raw materials (branches, leaves, etc.) from fallen trees. However, resources are halved due to damage during tree fall.
[*]TREES - Fallen tree now generates a proper number of tree logs (depending on tree size).
[*]CHAT - Added information where the new item is inserted ("INVENTORY" or "A2-A STORAGE").
[*]MISC - Destroying shrubs have a better sound and animation.
[*]MISC - Removed Tier from Armors' names - all armors are now TIER 0 - higher TIERs are automatically produced based on skills.
[*]MISC - The default icon (placeholder) is no longer so expressive + contains information that it is a placeholder.

[/list]

[h1]New content[/h1]
[list]
[*]Empty bucket - it is possible to craft in furniture section (1x board and 2x nails) - you can fill it with water and create "Bucket of water".
[*]Bucket of water - if you drink water, or use it in manufacturing and other activities - you'll get empty bucket back.
[*]Empty bottle (can be found in postapo anomaly) can be filled with water to create "Water bottle".
[*]Water bottle - if you drink water, or use it in manufacturing and other activities - you'll get empty bottle back.
[*]Wine - if you drink it, you'll get empty bottle back.
[*]Bucket of water / Empty bucket / Water bottle / Empty bottle - They have their own 3D models and can be used as decoration.
[/list]

[h1]Issue fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixed small backend issue with the any fireplace.
[*]Fertilize and waterring now won't drop below 0% anymore
[*]Fixed issue with dragging items and pressing ESC.
[*]Fixed a minor problem with the interaction with the surrounding objects.
[*]Fixed some bad translations.
[*]Fixed issue when character window is opened - character skill are now updated in realtime.
[/list]

notes.content:

Hello everybody, 
we have prepared for you next update, which focused much on performance and optimization.

At first glance it may appear that this is a small update - but the changes in the background a lot.

We focused on the CPU threads and generating the world.

notes.title: Update 0.08.014 - Improved construction mode!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/10304178/20845b8ee3deb4cfaebd2786c75e3fc67d5ddb19.png[/img]

We have prepared for you another update.

Which includes major new changes in building mode.
These changes are not yet perfect, but they serve as a new basis for further improvements.

Now you can filter between building parts - which facilitates better orientation.
It is also possible during the planning delete, move or copy an already scheduled parts!
We created a new core snap system - its no longer too complex placing parts - but you are trying to connect themselves to the permitted snap points already built parts.
Also, construction not longer governed according to the player's position (height);)

The new system is not perfect, but hopefully make your job easier during the construction of his home in Novus Inceptio ːnipictoː.

Remember, you can now also already built components disassembled into raw materials!

[b]Mainly we apologize for it now that the majority of your homes look broken :( Due to great overhaul of building tool, there are expected issues with planning some building parts (already finished parts before this update). Because of added snapping system, already planned/constructed DOORS, STAIRS, SMALL WALLS and some FENCES will be most probably displayed inproperly. To fix this, you'll need to salvage placed parts first and place/craft them again.[/b]
